dict.string: The camera is used by ARKit to detect surfaces so you can place 3-D reliquaries and Passion textiles in your physical space. No images leave your device.
Your location shows sanctuaries on the map and calibrates distances while the app is open.
The Pilgrim Guide monitors sanctuary geofences in the background so narration begins automatically as you approach each sacred site on the pilgrimage route — no continuous GPS, no map open.
